$comment: +++===+++ 2026-10-21 — Hasan Alizada — Temporary pip-audit exceptions (security baseline A03). Each entry must also be an --ignore-vuln flag of the root `security:audit` script, and expires: backend/tests/test_audit_ignores.py fails after the date or once the package is no longer at the listed version in uv.lock, so an exception can never outlive its reason. +++===+++ 2026-10-25 — Hasan Alizada — npm_ignores: the same for pnpm audit (pnpm-workspace.yaml auditConfig.ignoreGhsas; the version is the one in pnpm-lock.yaml).

ignores.reason: The fix (certifi 2026.10.19, released 2026-10-19) is younger than the 7-day minimum release age. certifi reaches us only through requests -> pip-audit in the dev group; the application and its image never load it. Upgrade on 2026-10-26 and remove this entry. Extended by one day on 2026-10-25 (owner-approved dependency deadlines): PyPI published 2026.10.19 on 2026-10-20 02:24 UTC, so it passes the 7-day minimum only at 2026-10-27 02:24 UTC. Upgrade on 2026-10-27 and remove this entry.

npm_ignores.reason: The fix (fast-uri 3.1.9, published 2026-10-19 23:05 UTC) passes the 7-day minimum release age only at 2026-10-26 23:05 UTC. Build time only: vite-plugin-pwa > workbox-build > ajv validates our own service-worker configuration with it; it never reaches the browser bundle or the server, and no untrusted URI is parsed. Added 2026-10-25; upgrade on 2026-10-27 (override) and remove this entry.

The fix (serialize-javascript 7.1.3, published 2026-10-22 21:24 UTC) passes the 7-day minimum release age only at 2026-10-29 21:24 UTC. Build time only: vite-plugin-pwa > workbox-build > @rollup/plugin-terser serializes our own build options; no user data is serialized and nothing of it ships. Added 2026-10-25; upgrade on 2026-10-30 (override) and remove this entry.
